title: Deeper/broader cross-codec legacy DXF and versioned DWG issue reconciliation
mode: Primary-source specification and issue-body review cross-checked against the current local parser, writer, and generated-test owners
scope: Retrieve full ACadSharp #1278, #1279, #1259, and #1261 issue bodies and reconcile only their exact reported routes with local behavior.
Cross-check LibreDWG #1354 legacy REPEAT/ENDREP/LOAD handling and ACadSharp #1172 entity-type counting ambiguity.
Audit the local DWG GeoData CIVIL-tail target-version predicate against ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.78 and specify the correction without changing code or tests.
Refine an existing classic-POLYLINE compatibility test for a generated AC1009 out-of-profile subclass-marker input.

local_source_files_inspected.areas: DRW_Polyline/DRW_Vertex DXF parsing and unknown group-code delegation
existing generated classic POLYLINE/VERTEX ASCII and Binary controls
existing CP949 declared-codepage and byte-payload round trip

local_checks: Read the authoritative local ODA v5.4.1 PDF, §20.4.78, pp. 202–203: objectVersion 1/2/3 and physical CIVIL-tail presence are separate axes; the tail applies to R21 and earlier, with an explicit note that AutoCAD 2010 always writes it.
Mapped target DWG releases using src/drw_base.h: AC1021/R21 is tail-positive; AC1024/R24 is tail-positive by the explicit AutoCAD-2010 exception; AC1027/R27 and AC1032/R32 are no-tail targets.

Compared the ODA matrix with DRW_GeoData::parseDwg, encodeDwg, and dwg_object_vectors_tests: the current continuous AC1021-through-AC1027 gate and AC1027 positive synthetic vectors repeat the same incorrect assumption; reopen PAR-119/7BP and correct both directions and tests.

Read the complete ACadSharp #1278 body: it reports AC1009 POLYLINE/VERTEX group-100 markers and losses in ACadSharp, but supplies no immutable file/hash or native result. Local unknown-code delegation suggests tolerance, not proof; specify a generated ASCII/Binary compatibility guard under existing PAR-14/7BS.

Read the complete ACadSharp #1279 body: its exact case is AC1014 2D POLYLINE with VERTEX children lacking AcDb2dVertex; the local generated AC1014 omission test already covers parent/child values and following-record alignment in ASCII and Binary.

Read the complete ACadSharp #1259 body and compared it with the local CP949 route: the existing test covers ANSI_949 with literal CP949 payload bytes and semantic sentinel readback; no duplicate local work is indicated.
Read the complete ACadSharp #1261 body: its private-file report omits target DWG magic and cannot resolve the ODA target-version boundary or independently establish its units diagnosis.
Rechecked LibreDWG #1354 against the local AC1.40 reader: REPEAT/ENDREP/LOAD remain explicitly unsupported and fail closed with existing diagnostics/controls; no array mapping is inferred.
Reconciled ACadSharp #1172 with the local type hierarchy: DRW_Table derives from DRW_Insert, so exact eType/handle/owner accounting is required; aggregate inherited-type counts are ambiguous.
Updated the plan summary, PAR-119/7BP target matrix and implementation sequence, and appended the cross-codec reconciliation. No code, tests, fixtures, dependency, CTest, or support claim changed.
method.validation: git diff --check on the plan passed before this receipt was added; final diff check and JSON parse are recorded in the turn. No build or local test was run because this was a plan-only research update.

findings.evidence: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.78 plus direct local source/test audit
findings.result: The current AC1021..AC1027 continuous tail gate is inconsistent with ODA. AC1021 and AC1024 are tail-positive; AC1027 and AC1032 are no-tail. Existing AC1027-positive generated vectors are not producer evidence and need replacement by no-tail boundary controls.
findings.limit: No native producer/application run was made; the change is a specification-backed local correction, not a support qualification.

findings.id: PAR-14/7BS AC1009 extra group-100 compatibility shape
findings.evidence: ACadSharp #1278 body, Autodesk R12 DXF reference, local parser source audit
findings.result: Add one generated ASCII/Binary AC1009 POLYLINE with three marked VERTEX children, SEQEND and a following LINE sentinel; assert identity/order/coordinates and marker-free R12 re-export. Do not change production code unless the focused guard fails.
findings.limit: The markers are outside the documented R12 profile; the peer issue does not establish a valid-R12 requirement or libdxfrw defect.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1278
sources.observed: Full body reports an AC1009 POLYLINE with three VERTEX children containing group-100 subclass strings and entity loss in ACadSharp 3.8.0/master; no public sample hash or native-consumer result is given.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer failure shape only; useful for a local permissive-parser compatibility test, not a format rule or local defect.

sources.name: Autodesk Release 12 DXF Reference
sources.observed: The R12 profile does not define group 100 as the later subclass-marker contract; the proposed marked input is therefore explicitly out-of-profile compatibility input.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Legacy DXF profile reference; it does not require a particular permissive recovery policy.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1279
sources.observed: Exact report is an AC1014 2D POLYLINE whose VERTEX child omits AcDb2dVertex after AcDbVertex; local generated compatibility coverage already exists.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer-specific reader behavior; not evidence of local failure or a reason to broaden child-role inference.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1259
sources.observed: Report distinguishes the $DWGCODEPAGE declaration from the actual encoded byte stream for CP949/ANSI_949 cases.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Synthetic peer report; local CP949 byte/text/sentinel controls are the relevant existing evidence.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1261
sources.observed: Reports a GeoData Civil-tail omission and possible units mismatch on private drawings but supplies no target DWG magic in the reviewed issue body.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer lead only; ODA v5.4.1 is authoritative for the local DWG byte-layout/version question.

sources.name: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1, §20.4.78
sources.observed: GeoData objectVersion values 1/2/3 map to AutoCAD 2009/2010/2013 body schemas, while the CIVIL tail is specified for target DWG R21 or earlier and a note states AutoCAD 2010 always writes it.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Authoritative wire-layout source under repository instructions; no actual producer output was executed in this pass.

sources.name: LibreDWG issue #1354
sources.observed: Reports pre-R13 REPEAT/ENDREP/LOAD pseudo-record output and lost array/resource semantics in a downstream DXF route.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer conversion report; local reader remains fail-closed and its existing controls are not broadened from an unresolved projection.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1172
sources.observed: Issue title reports missing AC1032 INSERT records; exact entity/handle/type accounting is needed to interpret the report.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer lead only; aggregate C++ inheritance counts can confuse DRW_Table with DRW_Insert.

existing_subplans_refined: PAR-119/7BP reopened for target-version gate and generated-vector correction
PAR-14/7BS made ready for one generated AC1009 out-of-profile compatibility control
